# PostUp mockups

> Static mockups of the PostUp app (v1034): 45 screens plus overlay sheets, four styles, phone and desktop. Each screen has implementation notes (purpose, behavior, links, states, copy, decisions with sources, and Overrides where a later decision beats the drawing). Read the notes with the screen.

Mockup URL pattern: /mockups/?style=<fresh|cozy|night|bold>&device=<phone|desktop>&auth=<out|in>&live=<live|none>#<screen> (overlays: &ov=<sheet>)
The home page (/) is #home, called Home, with two modes on one URL: Live and Building (?mode=live|building). #home-overlay-alt is an alternative, not chosen. #quiet is the old no-live home drawing; #quiet-feed / #quiet-feed-b are Nearby (/nearby). Project lists are headed "What people are building", sorted closest-first, showing the closest available even if none are local; never call them nearby unless they are (Martin, Oct 18).

## Notes
- [All screens in one file](notes/all.md): global rules, every screen, every source quote

## Critical flows
Critical flows (Martin, Oct 24 2026 [M1024]): a type of user arrives in a certain situation and goes through a scenario step by step. Each step names the screen and the scenario params (auth, live, Home mode, sheet). Flows marked Draft were inferred from the screen notes; confirm with Martin.
- [All flows in one file](flows/all.md)
- [cautious-joiner](flows/cautious-joiner.md): Cautious joiner checks a few postups, then joins (MVP must) · player: flows/cautious-joiner.html
- [quick-joiner](flows/quick-joiner.md): Quick joiner (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/quick-joiner.html
- [first-visit-live](flows/first-visit-live.md): First-time visitor, someone is live (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/first-visit-live.html
- [first-visit-none](flows/first-visit-none.md): First-time visitor, nobody live (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/first-visit-none.html
- [invite-live](flows/invite-live.md): Share link to a live postup (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/invite-live.html
- [invite-ended](flows/invite-ended.md): Share link to an ended postup (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/invite-ended.html
- [invite-project](flows/invite-project.md): Share link to a project (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/invite-project.html
- [ask-join](flows/ask-join.md): Ask to join, then get approved (joiner side) (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/ask-join.html
- [host-approve](flows/host-approve.md): Host approves a request (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/host-approve.html
- [first-post](flows/first-post.md): First post up (with sign-in) (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/first-post.html
- [returning-post](flows/returning-post.md): Returning poster (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/returning-post.html
- [hosting](flows/hosting.md): Hosting live: extend, edit, end (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/hosting.html
- [project-builder](flows/project-builder.md): Project builder: create, update, post up for it (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/project-builder.html
- [following](flows/following.md): Follow a person or project (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/following.html
- [chat](flows/chat.md): Postup chat (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/chat.html
- [safety](flows/safety.md): Report and block (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/safety.html
- [leave](flows/leave.md): Leave a postup you joined (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/leave.html
- [postup-states](flows/postup-states.md): Postup ends, fills or is cancelled while you look (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/postup-states.html
- [empty-area](flows/empty-area.md): Empty area: be the first (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/empty-area.html
- [loading-offline](flows/loading-offline.md): Slow network and offline (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/loading-offline.html
- [delete-account](flows/delete-account.md): Delete account (MVP must, draft) · player: flows/delete-account.html
- [desktop-browse](flows/desktop-browse.md): Desktop browse and post (nice, draft) · player: flows/desktop-browse.html
- [settings-notify](flows/settings-notify.md): Notification settings and sign out (nice, draft) · player: flows/settings-notify.html
